values.note: $26 a night Memorial Day weekend through Labor Day weekend; $10 a night in the off season (no water, trash or host). Cash or check at the fee box.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/riogrande/recreation/road-canyon-campground ('Single Site: $26 per night | Single Site: $10 per night (during shoulder season)'; 'From Memorial Day weekend through Labor Day weekend, there are higher fees and trash service'; 'Off-season fees of $10.00/night apply'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: 6 camping units, each with a parking spur, table and fire ring; 'Maximum spur length is 50 feet. Not all sites will fit vehicles of this length.' An undeveloped overflow camping area is directly across the road.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/riogrande/recreation/road-canyon-campground ('It has 6 camping units, each with a parking spur, table, and fire ring. An undeveloped overflow camping area is directly across the road.'; 'Maximum spur length is 50 feet. Not all sites will fit vehicles of this length.'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: No firewood or drinking water; trash service only Memorial Day to Labor Day (pack it out otherwise).

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/riogrande/recreation/road-canyon-campground ('A vault type toilet is provided. No firewood or drinking water are available.'; 'Outside of the summer season, there is no trash service.'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Open year-round but may be inaccessible due to snow or spring road closures (FS); in winter the county plows FR 520 to Road Canyon Reservoir.

values.note: 50% off single campsites only, for the site the pass holder occupies.

note: Rio Grande NF, ~6 mi west on FR 520 (Rio Grande Reservoir Rd) off Hwy 149 (~20 mi SW of Creede), ~9,300 ft, in an open treeless meadow at the head of Road Canyon Reservoir, not screened from the road (sites not at the shoreline). Fishing access and a primitive boat launch on the reservoir (no wakes, trolling motors OK). Usually has vacancy when the upriver campgrounds are full. --Claude
summary: FS page: confirmed 6 units, max spur 50 ft, $26 peak/$10 off-season, vault toilet, no drinking water, first-come only (no recreation.gov listing). Added year-round season (snow/spring-closure caveat), 14-night limit, senior-pass discount, overflow-area and trash notes, fees checked 2026. Note trimmed of field facts.
flags: Phone missing: Divide Ranger District (719) 657-3321 (FS campground page contact; 13308 West US Hwy 160, Del Norte).

Waterfront (stored lakeview) kept: the campground sits in an open meadow between Road Canyon Reservoir (No. 1, to the north-east, whose south-western head is willow marsh on Esri imagery) and Road Canyon Reservoir No. 2 to the south; open water is ~200-300 m from the loop on both imagery and the World_Topo_Map shoreline, across open meadow with no trees, so visible but not frontage. The FS page: 'located at the head of Road Canyon Reservoir'. Special Order RG-94-05 (1994, in force) bans camping between FDR 520's west side and the reservoir's west waterline near the dam, not at the campground.

Road: FR 520 is Open in the Divide RD road table (June 11, 2026); 'Passenger car accessible to Lost Trail Trailhead' (well beyond this campground). Not among the roads damaged in the October 22-23, 2026 floods on the conditions page.
Pin 37.75505,-107.19268 matches the FS coordinates (37.75504726,-107.1926782), inside the loop. OK.
